IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Roach, Buck, Kristiansen, Grant and Blake

Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting certain fish from the tax levied under RCW 82.08.020.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to sales tax on fish caught at a private fishingfacility; and adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 shall not apply to fish caught ata private fishing facility. For the purposes of this section, a"private fishing facility" means a facility managed by an "aquaticfarmer" as defined in RCW 15.85.020.
